requirements.summary: One deterministic shared selector distributes player and bot spawns
requirements.expected: Every player and bot deployment scores the complete valid candidate pool using threat distance, line-of-sight safety, recent death pressure, recent-use avoidance, occupancy, repeat avoidance and team-side awareness where applicable.
requirements.falsifier: A runtime path still selects only the first point, a side-local list, or a point used within the avoidance window while a fresh valid alternative exists.

evidence.note: Pins 200 seeded deployments, 80% coverage, avoidance-window behavior, threat monotonicity, deterministic ties and TDM side preference.
The player and bot deployment paths call the shared module; the call-site delta is 30 LF lines, with the selector logic isolated in src/spawn-selection.ts.

requirements.summary: All 11 registered arena spawn tables meet count and spread floors
requirements.expected: Each team arena has at least eight player/bot points per team, each explore arena retains its authored five-point contract, and every table meets its recorded spread and mean-nearest-neighbour floor.
requirements.falsifier: Any registered row, including parked farcrysis, has a count, spread, floor, route, cover, standoff, open-arc or cross-team failure.

evidence.note: All registered rows are measured and the explicit per-arena count/spread/mean-NN floor table is pinned.
All 11 rows report in-envelope 100%, floor 100%, reach 100% and verdict ok.

requirements.summary: Nuke Town Rebuild has distributed authored bot points without geometry edits
requirements.expected: nuketown2 offers eight gate-passing points per team across the house-side yards, street-end and cul-de-sac approach; no added point is inside the truck or coach, and only the spawn declaration changes.
requirements.falsifier: The source diff changes nuketown2 geometry, or the built audit finds an added point inside geometry, without floor/route/cover/standoff/open-arc/LOS validity.

evidence.note: Only NUKETOWN2_SPAWN_LAYOUT changed; the added points are [1,-40], [-16,-40] and exact rotational partners.
